item.title: Solved: How to Efficiently Get All Divisors of a Number
item.description:
Question:

What is the most effective way to determine all the divisors of a given number using Python?

Many approaches exist, but let’s explore an optimized version that surpasses the basic method, which simply checks every integer up to half of the number. Here’s a common naive implementation:

def naive_divisor_generator(n):
    for i in range(1, n // 2 + 1):
        if n % i == 0: 
            yield i
    yield n

While this approach works, it can be sluggish, especially for larger numbers. An improved algorithm can drastically reduce the computation time.
